corrections.agentSaid: Difficulty medium: I marked this medium because registration is quick, but real users can hit org-owner approval, OAuth-app rate limits, and optional Marketplace verification; OAuth apps also have less fine-grained control than GitHub Apps.
corrections.actually: Difficulty easy. GitHub does not review OAuth apps. Organization approval is a setting each customer organization controls, and a Marketplace listing is optional, so neither should set the difficulty.

notes: Checked by hand: the 2,000 access token requests per hour limit is on the GitHub rate limits page, word for word.
